name: Mission Shakti
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Women and girls needing safety, security, support or empowerment services
eligibility: Implemented as an umbrella programme for women safety, security and empowerment.
benefits: Integrated support for safety, security, empowerment, shelter, maternity support and information/services through its components.
documents: Identity/residence documents as required by the concerned component
application_process: Apply/use the relevant component through the designated government department, service centre, portal or implementing agency.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
